meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先读 logs/setup-migration/handoff.json，再收尾 NanoClaw v1→v2 迁移：确认并授予 owner 角色、跑旧记忆迁移、核对容器配置、协助移植 v1 自定义代码。
howto.when: 在 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 跑完、把控制权交回 Claude 后触发；当你提到 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration” 等词时也会接管。若 handoff.json 不存在，它会停下让你先在终端运行该脚本。

say.text: migrate-v2.sh 跑完了，帮我收尾 v1 迁移
给我这个账号加上 owner 角色
把我的 v1 自定义 skill 移植到 v2
say.note: 复制可移植文件，并标出 v1 残留引用

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads logs/setup-migration/handoff.json and finishes the NanoClaw v1→v2 migration: granting the owner role, running the legacy memory migration, checking container configs, and helping port custom v1 code.
howto.when_en: Triggered after `bash migrate-v2.sh` finishes and hands control back to Claude, or when you say "migrate from v1", "finish migration" and similar. If handoff.json is missing, it stops and asks you to run that script first.

say_en.text: migrate-v2.sh finished — help me wrap up the v1 migration
say_en.note: Reads handoff.json, then works phase by phase

say_en.text: Grant this account the owner role
say_en.note: Uses getUserRoles/grantRole for the global owner

say_en.text: Port my custom v1 skills to v2
say_en.note: Copies portable files, flags v1-only references
